beats.hook: My neighbor called the cops on my kids' birthday party. So I made sure his illegal rental property got shut down — permanently.
beats.normal_life: Dale and I had lived side by side for three years without a single issue. He even waved to my daughter Mia on her way to school every morning.
beats.first_red_flag: Then we hosted Mia's seventh birthday. Fourteen kids, a piñata, and music that ended at six p.m. Dale called the police twice.
beats.the_reveal: While I was fuming that night, my husband noticed something — Dale's detached garage had three separate power meters, three doorbells, and curtains in every window. He was running an unlicensed rooming house. Had been for years.
beats.aftermath: I filed an anonymous tip with the city housing office. Gave them photos, dates, meter readings — everything. Six weeks later, Dale had an eviction notice on his garage door and a five-thousand-dollar fine in his mailbox. He never waved at Mia again. Honestly? Good.
beats.cta: Was this petty — or did Dale earn every bit of it? Drop your verdict below.
